review_candidates.title: Senior Data Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: To design, build, and maintain scalable data infrastructure and pipelines that enable reliable, efficient, and secure data flow for analytics, business intelligence, and AI/ML initiatives. RESPONSIBILITIES Design, develop, and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest data from multiple sources (Oracle ERP, production systems, WMS, IoT sensors, external APIs). Optimize storage, partitioning, and query performance for large-scale datasets used by data analysts and data scientists Build and main
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Collaborate with data scientists to understand data requirements for predictive modeling, forecasting, and optimization algorithms. Tune SQL queries, pipeline performance, and data processing jobs to meet SLA requirements for dashboards and AI model refreshes. Work closely with Data Analysts, BI Developers, and Data Scientists to understand data requirements for dashboards, reports, and models. REQUIREMENTS Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. 5–8 years of experience in data engineering, ETL/ELT development, or data warehousing.
